notes.title: Some fixes&improvements&balance changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Headbanger: increased explosion radius +30% and explosion damage +66%
[*] Double barreled shotgun: increased damage for all types of ammo +100% and penetration +50%
[*] Removed some parts of enemies projectiles impact effects to reduce bright flash effects when they hit player
[*] Limited camera shake power for incoming damage
[*] Brightened up some places on level 2 and 5
[*] Fixed Wendigo sometimes stays in place for 1-2 seconds
[*] Fixed on level 2 if load save at the very bottom of pyramid portal didn't show up
[*] Fixed on level 5 in dark vertical tunnel with jump pad light didn't show up in time
[/list]

Those are the changes I wanted to make after my own playtesting while recording gameplay for new trailer.
If you have encountered any other issues or have any suggestions feel free to share them with me, thanks!

notes.title: Enhanced visuals, improved movement, better CPU performance, and many other
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4T4WQvkw8Bs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved visuals with better lighting, crispier look and less ghosting during movement
[*] Added proper shader precompilation
[*] Made player movement more responsive
[*] Changed default fov to 110
[*] Updated main menu
[*] Changed some parts of the map on levels 1 and 4
[*] Updated soundtrack
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented Interpolated enemies spawn - to fix stutters when spawning lots of enemies at the same time
[*] Done VFX optimizations
[*] Many CPU performance improvements
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed game icon at the bottom of Windows ( was default UE icon )
[*] Fixed wall cannons projectile sometimes exploded on spawn if player far away
[*] Removed redundant video settings
[*] Many other small improvements&fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Guns&Fights changes and Cheats menu
notes.content:
[h2]Headbanger[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased explosion radius by 30%
[*] Explosion triggers on any headshot (previously only on head exploding shots)
[*] Bullet penetrates up to 2 enemies (3 enemies can be hit by one shot)
[*] Increased bullet damage
[/list]
[h2]Heavy Rifle[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now uses explodable projectiles that explodes on impact
[*] Projectile speed lowered
[/list]

[h2]Level 5 big arena fight (where you find the Headbanger)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed layout by adding some walls to lower level and changed floors on upper level
[*] Added more jump pads including the ones that push you to other side of arena
[*] Added poisonous clouds to lower level
[*] Added portals between lower and upper level
[*] [b]Overall now it's harder to run in circles from enemies on lower level, but to not get stuck by horde there are now portals to upper level. And it's easier to shot enemies/get hit by them while being on upper level[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Level 5 final boss fight[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added melee attack reload time for bosses
[*] Reduced melee attack radius for bosses
[*] Now damage boosters are spawned in place of dead bosses
[*] Now final portal is shown once you kill bosses even if many enemies are still alive
[*] [b]After killing bosses, all enemies will fall back to defend portal from player[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Added cheats menu[/h2]
[list]
[*] Auto heal per second (I think that invincibility is too boring)
[*] Damage multiplier
[*] Gore impulse multiplier (not affecting achievements)
[*] Infinite ammo
[*] Unlock all guns
[*]
[list]
[*] Cheats menu are available via pause menu when player completed current level on HARD difficulty OR via some action in pause menu
[*] Level always starts with cheats disabled, even if cheats was enabled in previous level
[*] HARD achievements are disabled when any cheat is active except "Gore impulse multiplier"
[/list]
[/list]


[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed ability to jump out of level 2
[*] Fixed ability to fly out of level 5 if player hit by boss while being in air
[*] Fixed Headbanger key remapping didn't work
[*] Made checkboxes in UI more visible
[*] Fixed level 5 achievement typo
[/list]

Special thanks to JarekTheGamingDragon for his awesome review video from where I mainly took inspiration for this update
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=geFUBALo33s
